# TraeCN MCP Full Documentation

> Model Context Protocol (MCP) server connecting external AI agents to TraeCN IDE on macOS via CDP.

- **Repository**: https://github.com/Luckycat133/traecn-mcp
- **Author**: Luckycat133
- **License**: MIT
- **Protocol**: MCP JSON-RPC 2.0 stdio
- **Runtime**: Node.js >= 22 (macOS)
- **Local Gateway & Web Console**: http://127.0.0.1:8788

---

## 1. Architecture Overview

```text
Agent host → TraeCN MCP (stdio) → local gateway (HTTP/WebSocket) → TraeCN (CDP)
```

TraeCN MCP operates via Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) into the running TraeCN desktop app:
- 0 macOS Accessibility or Screen Recording permissions required.
- Robust against minimized or occluded windows.
- Local gateway manages task queues, background polling, and completion delivery.
- Built-in Web Console at `127.0.0.1:8788` for human oversight and task diagnostics.

---

## 2. Quickstart & Installation

```bash
# From source checkout
npm ci
npm run quickstart -- --launch-trae

# Or via Homebrew
brew tap Luckycat133/traecn-mcp https://github.com/Luckycat133/traecn-mcp.git
brew install Luckycat133/traecn-mcp/traecnclaw
traecn-mcp quickstart --launch-trae
```

### Client Configuration (`claude_desktop_config.json` or `~/.cursor/mcp.json`)
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "traecn": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": ["/path/to/traecn-mcp/mcp-server.js"]
    }
  }
}
```

---

## 3. Core MCP Tools (20 Tools)

- `traecn_send_message`: Delegate task to TraeCN and receive task tracking handle.
- `traecn_get_task`: Inspect current execution status, model thoughts, and generated diffs.
- `traecn_list_workspaces`: Discover active and historical project workspaces.
- `traecn_select_workspace`: Focus and switch active workspace.
- `traecn_answer_question`: Answer interactive prompts and confirmations.
- `traecn_select_model`: Switch between supported LLMs (Claude 3.7 Sonnet, DeepSeek V3, etc.).
- `traecn_check_in`: Claim daily check-in rewards and read account status.
- `traecn_cancel_task`: Abort currently running generation.

---

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Q: Why use TraeCN MCP instead of using Trae directly?
TraeCN MCP enables multi-agent orchestration. You can use Claude Desktop, Cursor, or CI scripts as the master planner, delegating specific coding implementations to TraeCN programmatically.

### Q: Does it require screen recording permissions?
No. Because TraeCN is built on Chromium, TraeCN MCP uses direct Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) for DOM inspection and input emulation.
